summary: IDT Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its subsidiary IDT Telecom's revolving credit agreement with TD Bank. The amendment increases seasonal borrowing capacity to $50 million in May and December, adds three guarantors, and extends maturity to July 15, 2029. This is a routine credit facility amendment with no special-situation characteristics. No shares, pricing, or strategic actions are involved. Watch for continued normal operations under the extended facility.
